about: Freelance piano tuner and technician working alone for households, a church and a music school; a quiet inbox

messages.subject: Invoice #1042
messages.body:
Hi Walter,

Attached is invoice #1042 for Friday's tuning and the two key bushings: $185. Check or bank transfer is fine. The piano should hold well now that the humidifier is running.

Thanks,
Greta

messages.subject: Re: Invoice #1042
messages.body: Check is in the mail. Sounds lovely, my wife has been playing every night. Walter

messages.subject: Order 1042 shipped
messages.body: Hi Greta, your order 1042 shipped today: 2 boxes of 2/0 tuning pins and a roll of bushing cloth. Tracking is in your account. Thanks! Deb, Keystone Piano Supply

messages.subject: Middle C sticking
messages.body:
Dear Greta,

Middle C on my piano has started sticking down and doesn't come back up. My granddaughter's recital is Saturday, November 14 and she practices here every day. Could you come by this week?

Warmly,
June Albright

messages.subject: Re: Middle C sticking
messages.body: Hi June, of course. I can come tomorrow, Thursday, at 10. Greta

messages.subject: Re: Middle C sticking
messages.body: Greta, don't come today! My grandson found a pencil wedged under the key. It works perfectly now. So sorry for the bother. Please keep me down for my usual spring tuning. June

messages.subject: sticky keys
messages.body: Hi Greta, since we turned the heat on a few keys in the upper octave stick a bit. Not urgent but can you look at it when you're around? Liam

messages.subject: Re: sticky keys
messages.body: Hi Liam, that's the season. I can stop by Tuesday afternoon and ease them. Greta

messages.subject: Practice room pianos before juries
messages.body:
Hello Greta,

Could you tune the three practice-room uprights (rooms 4, 5 and 7) before our December 10 juries? Any weekday works, the building opens at 8.

Thank you,
Paul Okafor
Operations, Riverbend Music School

messages.subject: Riverbend tunings (resending)
messages.body: Hi Greta, Paul from Riverbend here, sending from my personal email in case our school filter ate my message yesterday. We'd like the three practice room uprights tuned before juries on December 10. Thanks! Paul

messages.subject: Re: Riverbend tunings (resending)
messages.body: Hi Paul, got both, thanks. I'll do all three on Tuesday, December 1, starting at 8. Greta

messages.subject: Das alte Klavier
messages.body:
Liebe Greta,

ich habe mich entschieden, das alte Klavier zu verkaufen, ich spiele ja kaum noch. Die Nachbarin will es haben. Careful Keys Moving hat mir 350 Dollar für den Transport angeboten, die waren sehr freundlich am Telefon. Ist das ein fairer Preis?

Alles Liebe,
Mama

messages.subject: Re: Das alte Klavier
messages.body:
Liebe Mama,

ja, 350 Dollar ist fair für ein Klavier mit Treppe. Schön, dass es in der Nachbarschaft bleibt!

Kuss,
Greta

messages.subject: Moving the grand
messages.body: Hi Greta, we're moving to the new house on December 1. Who would you trust to move the grand? And can you tune it once it has settled in? Ines

messages.subject: Guild Journal: music wire prices climb
messages.body: In this issue: why music wire prices are rising, a regulation checklist for older uprights, and member news.

messages.subject: Stock up on music wire before January price change
messages.body: Music wire prices go up January 1. Order now at current prices; free shipping over $150.

messages.subject: Webinar: restringing when wire costs more
messages.body: Join us for a free webinar on restringing, splicing and saving on wire as prices rise.

messages.subject: Tuning before the Harvest Festival concert
messages.body:
Dear Greta,

Our Harvest Festival concert is Saturday, September 26. Could you tune the sanctuary piano sometime the week before?

Blessings,
Ruth Ann Mayer
Music Director, St. Columba Church

messages.subject: Re: Tuning before the Harvest Festival concert
messages.body: Hi Ruth Ann, happy to. I'll come Tuesday the 22nd at 9. Greta

messages.subject: Hall piano for the festival
messages.body: Hi Greta, the festival on the 26th uses our hall piano for the afternoon show. Could you tune it Thursday the 24th? Bob, Linden Community Hall

messages.subject: Re: Hall piano for the festival
messages.body: Yes, Thursday the 24th at 1pm works. Greta

messages.subject: Tuning
messages.body: Hi, a friend recommended you. Our piano hasn't been tuned in three years (oops). Do you have time in the next few weeks? Nora

messages.subject: Re: Tuning
messages.body: Hi Nora, no shame, it happens. After three years it may need a pitch raise too. I could come Wednesday, September 30 at 2. Greta

messages.subject: Re: Tuning
messages.body: Perfect, see you then!

messages.subject: Your statement is ready
messages.body: Your monthly statement is ready to view online.

messages.subject: coffee?
messages.body: Coffee Saturday morning? The new place by the river. E

messages.subject: Groeten uit Haarlem
messages.body:
Hoi Greta,

Lang niet gesproken! Ik speel nog steeds op die oude vleugel die jij twee jaar geleden hebt gestemd toen je hier was. Hij klinkt nog prima. Hoe is het in Linden?

Groet,
Joost

messages.subject: Re: Groeten uit Haarlem
messages.body: Hoi Joost! Wat leuk. Hier is alles rustig, veel stemwerk in de herfst. Fijn dat de vleugel het nog doet. Groetjes, Greta

messages.subject: New this week
messages.body: New dramas and a concert film. Start watching tonight.

messages.subject: Thank you
messages.body: Greta, the piano sounded wonderful at yesterday's concert. Several people asked who tunes it. Thank you! Ruth Ann

messages.subject: Old piano - worth it?
messages.body: Hi Greta, we inherited a 1950s upright that is way flat. What would a pitch raise and tuning cost? Mark

messages.subject: Re: Old piano - worth it?
messages.body: Hi Mark, a pitch raise plus fine tuning is $260, and I'd recommend a follow-up tuning about three months later. Greta

messages.subject: Re: Old piano - worth it?
messages.body: Thanks. We'll do it in the spring once we've cleared the room.

messages.subject: coat??
messages.body: Mom can you mail my winter coat? It got cold here SO fast. Love you

messages.subject: Re: coat??
messages.body: Mailing it tomorrow, with cookies. Love you too.

messages.subject: November at the library
messages.body: Author talks, a seed swap, and the return of the Sunday chamber music series.

messages.subject: Your monthly statement
messages.body: Your October statement is available. Balance due: $0.00.

messages.subject: Flu shots available
messages.body: Walk-in flu shots are available weekdays 8-4. No appointment needed.

messages.subject: Accord du piano
messages.body:
Bonjour Greta,

Notre piano a besoin d'un accord avant les fêtes. Seriez-vous disponible le jeudi 22 octobre dans l'après-midi ?

Merci,
Sophie Laurent

messages.subject: Re: Accord du piano
messages.body:
Bonjour Sophie,

Oui, jeudi 22 octobre à 14 h, c'est parfait.

Cordialement,
Greta

messages.subject: Re: Accord du piano
messages.body: Merci beaucoup, à jeudi !

messages.subject: leaves
messages.body: Hi Greta, I'm renting a leaf blower Saturday, happy to do your side of the driveway too. Hank

messages.subject: Re: leaves
messages.body: You're a saint, Hank. Pie is on me.

messages.subject: Your auto policy documents
messages.body: Your renewed auto policy documents are ready to download.

messages.subject: Thanksgiving
messages.body: Liebe Greta, kommt ihr an Thanksgiving zu mir? Ich mache wieder den Rotkohl. Das Klavier ist übrigens schon abgeholt, alles gut gegangen. Mama

messages.subject: Re: Thanksgiving
messages.body: Ja, natürlich! Mia kommt auch. Wir bringen den Nachtisch mit. Kuss, Greta

messages.subject: New in town, piano needs tuning
messages.body: Hi Greta, we just moved to Linden and the piano made the trip from Ohio. It sounds rough. When could you come? Victor

messages.subject: Re: New in town, piano needs tuning
messages.body: Welcome to Linden! Best to let it settle two weeks after a move. How about Monday, November 16 at 10? Greta

messages.subject: Re: New in town, piano needs tuning
messages.body: Works for us. Thanks!

messages.subject: Chapter meeting: hammer voicing demo
messages.body: Our November chapter meeting features a hammer voicing demo. Members and guests welcome.

messages.subject: movie friday?
messages.body: Movie Friday the 13th? Spooky date, spooky film. E

messages.subject: Re: movie friday?
messages.body: Only if you hold my hand. Yes!

messages.subject: Afinación del piano
messages.body: Hola Greta, ¿podría afinar nuestro piano en octubre? Mi hijo empieza clases y la profesora dice que está desafinado. Gracias, Marisol Vega

messages.subject: Re: Afinación del piano
messages.body: Hola Marisol, claro que sí. ¿Le viene bien el martes 6 de octubre a las 4? Un saludo, Greta

messages.subject: Thanksgiving deals inside
messages.body: Turkeys, pies and sides: this week's best prices.

messages.subject: Arts Council newsletter
messages.body: Fall grant deadlines, the Harvest Festival lineup, and volunteer calls.

messages.subject: home soon!
messages.body: Bus gets in Tuesday the 24th at 6pm! Can you pick me up? Can't wait to see Oma.

messages.subject: Invoice #1042 was viewed
messages.body: Walter Pruitt viewed invoice #1042 ($185.00).

messages.subject: borrow your mutes?
messages.body: Hey Greta, could I borrow your felt temperament strip and a couple of rubber mutes this weekend? Mine went missing at a job. Arne

messages.subject: Re: borrow your mutes?
messages.body: Sure, they're in a bag on my porch. Return whenever.

traps.what: Number 1042 is both the owner's invoice to Walter and a Keystone supply order; unrelated.
June's sticking key looked like part of a seasonal sticky-key pattern with Liam, but June's was a pencil and is settled; Liam's is a normal single visit.
Two requests to tune Riverbend's practice pianos are one person on two addresses; already booked.
The owner's mother's piano mover (personal) and a client asking for a mover recommendation (work) must not be joined.
The rising music wire price pattern appears only in newsletters, a promo and a webinar.
The church and the community hall both needed tuning for the Sept 26 Harvest Festival; that date is long over.
